tools.name: find_effects
tools.description: Lists pixel art effects, built-in and the project's, matching words, a category or where they are. Look here before writing a new effect.

tools.name: read_effect
tools.description: Returns an effect's source code and meta.

tools.name: copy_effect
tools.description: Copies a built-in effect into the project as pixelfx/fx/<category>/<name>.js, with the pixelfx core and helpers it imports, and shows it. Returns its id and the files written.

tools.name: write_effect
tools.description: Writes a project effect's code, adds the core files it imports when missing, then checks it. Returns errors and warnings; fix errors, then look with panel_screenshot.

tools.name: check_effect
tools.description: Checks an effect: meta, pixels outside the canvas, loop seams, one-shots that don't end empty, seeded randomness, palettes and frame time.

tools.name: show_effect
tools.description: Shows an effect in the Pixel Effects panel with preview settings, so panel_screenshot can see it. Returns the settings in use.

tools.name: export_effect
tools.description: Exports the effect shown, with its preview settings, as a sprite sheet, contact sheet, GIF or PNG frames. Returns where it went.
